name: PCCW Limited
summary: PCCW Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications and related services in Hong Kong, Mainland and other parts of China, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through HKT Limited (HKT), Media Business, and Other Businesses of the Group (Other Businesses) segments. The company offers local telephony, local data and broadband, mobile, enterprise solutions, international telecommunications, and network-based telecommunications services; outsourcing and contact center services; IT solutions; and technical consulting and engineering services.
